checks.criterion: Admin area is protected by a six-digit PIN and supports logout

checks.evidence: POST /api/admin/login wrong PIN -> 401; GET /api/admin/orders unauth -> 401/403; correct PIN -> 200 authenticated:true; GET /api/admin/orders -> 200; logout -> 200 authenticated:false; orders blocked again -> 401/403. 3 tests passed in 0.99s.
